sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_registrations" ("source_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY COLLATE BINARY CHECK (length(source_id) > 0 AND instr(source_id, char(0)) = 0), "display_name" TEXT, "availability" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (availability IN ('available', 'unavailable', 'unresolved')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "library_entries" ("source_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY REFERENCES source_registrations(source_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY CHECK (length(book_id) > 0 AND instr(book_id, char(0)) = 0), "saved" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (saved IN (0, 1)), "metadata_state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (metadata_state IN ('known', 'stub')), "title" TEXT, "author" TEXT, "description" TEXT, "cover_asset_id" TEXT COLLATE BINARY CHECK (cover_asset_id IS NULL OR(length(cover_asset_id) > 0 AND instr(cover_asset_id, char(0)) = 0)), "known_total_chapters" INTEGER, "update_flag" INTEGER CHECK (update_flag IS NULL OR update_flag IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY(source_id, book_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "book_tags" ("source_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0), "tag" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(source_id, book_id, ordinal), FOREIGN KEY(source_id, book_id)REFERENCES library_entries(source_id, book_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_book_metadata" ("source_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "legacy_source_name" TEXT, "total_chapters" INTEGER, "last_chapter" INTEGER, "hits" INTEGER, "cover_index" INTEGER, "has_update" INTEGER CHECK (has_update IS NULL OR has_update IN (0, 1)), "cover_reference" TEXT, "publishing_house" TEXT, "last_update" TEXT, "is_completed" INTEGER CHECK (is_completed IS NULL OR is_completed IN (0, 1)), "word_count_k" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(source_id, book_id), FOREIGN KEY(source_id, book_id)REFERENCES library_entries(source_id, book_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shelves" ("shelf_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY COLLATE BINARY CHECK (length(shelf_id) > 0 AND instr(shelf_id, char(0)) = 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shelf_members" ("shelf_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY REFERENCES shelves(shelf_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0), PRIMARY KEY(shelf_id, source_id, book_id), UNIQUE(shelf_id, ordinal), FOREIGN KEY(source_id, book_id)REFERENCES library_entries(source_id, book_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "manual_groups" ("group_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY COLLATE BINARY CHECK (length(group_id) > 0 AND instr(group_id, char(0)) = 0), "display_name" TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_members" ("group_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY REFERENCES manual_groups(group_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, PRIMARY KEY(group_id, source_id, book_id), FOREIGN KEY(source_id, book_id)REFERENCES library_entries(source_id, book_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "split_overrides" ("source_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "is_split" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_split IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY(source_id, book_id), FOREIGN KEY(source_id, book_id)REFERENCES library_entries(source_id, book_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "migration_datasets" ("dataset_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY COLLATE BINARY CHECK (length(dataset_id) > 0 AND instr(dataset_id, char(0)) = 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "migration_runs" ("dataset_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY REFERENCES migration_datasets(dataset_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "importer_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (importer_version > 0), "input_digest" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(input_digest) = 64 AND input_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), "mapping_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (mapping_version > 0), "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'applying', 'verifying', 'complete', 'partial', 'failed')), "expected_units" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (expected_units >= 0), "verified_units" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (verified_units >= 0), PRIMARY KEY(dataset_id, importer_version, input_digest));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "record_receipts" ("dataset_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY REFERENCES migration_datasets(dataset_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "importer_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (importer_version > 0), "entity_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entity_kind IN ('source', 'book', 'shelf', 'group', 'split', 'progress', 'readerPreferences', 'appPreferences', 'statistics', 'searchHistory', 'catalog')), "legacy_key" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, PRIMARY KEY(dataset_id, importer_version, entity_kind, legacy_key));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "record_outcomes" ("dataset_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "importer_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "input_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_key" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('imported', 'unchanged', 'preserved-unresolved', 'deferred-preserved', 'intentionally-excluded', 'failed', 'conflict')), "diagnostic_code" TEXT CHECK (diagnostic_code IS NULL OR diagnostic_code IN ('invalid-field', 'unknown-field', 'unsupported', 'missing-evidence', 'conflicting-evidence', 'verification-failed', 'secret-excluded')), "omitted_field_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (omitted_field_count >= 0), PRIMARY KEY(dataset_id, importer_version, input_digest, entity_kind, legacy_key), FOREIGN KEY(dataset_id, importer_version, input_digest)REFERENCES migration_runs(dataset_id, importer_version, input_digest)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY(dataset_id, importer_version, entity_kind, legacy_key)REFERENCES record_receipts(dataset_id, importer_version, entity_kind, legacy_key)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "safe_legacy_values" ("dataset_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "importer_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "entity_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_key" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "candidate_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY CHECK (length(candidate_id) > 0), "field" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (field IN ('book.id', 'book.title', 'book.author', 'book.source', 'book.intro', 'book.tag', 'book.totalChapters', 'book.lastChapter', 'book.hits', 'book.coverIndex', 'book.hasUpdate', 'book.coverReference', 'book.publishingHouse', 'book.lastUpdate', 'book.isCompleted', 'book.wordCountK', 'book.saved', 'source.name', 'source.byIdName', 'source.preferred', 'shelf.id', 'shelf.name', 'shelf.ordinal', 'shelf.member', 'group.id', 'group.name', 'group.member', 'group.autoRename', 'split.bookId', 'progress.lastChapter', 'progress.bookLastChapter', 'progress.offset', 'progress.hasRead', 'progress.appleDate', 'progress.knownTotal', 'progress.updateFlag', 'reader.fontSize', 'reader.lineSpacing', 'reader.backgroundIndex', 'reader.mode', 'reader.fontFamily', 'reader.bold', 'reader.marginLeft', 'reader.marginRight', 'reader.marginTop', 'reader.marginBottom', 'app.theme', 'app.selectedShelf', 'app.accent', 'stats.dailySeconds', 'stats.dailyChapters', 'stats.bookSeconds', 'search.term', 'catalog.index', 'catalog.title', 'catalog.volume', 'catalog.remoteId')), "map_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE BINARY, "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (ordinal >= 0), "value_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (value_type IN ('string', 'integer', 'number', 'boolean', 'null')), "text_value" TEXT, "integer_value" INTEGER, "number_value" REAL CHECK (number_value IS NULL OR(number_value - number_value)IS NOT NULL), "boolean_value" INTEGER CHECK (boolean_value IS NULL OR boolean_value IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY(dataset_id, importer_version, entity_kind, legacy_key, candidate_id, field, map_key, ordinal), FOREIGN KEY(dataset_id, importer_version, entity_kind, legacy_key)REFERENCES record_receipts(dataset_id, importer_version, entity_kind, legacy_key)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK((value_type = 'string' AND text_value IS NOT NULL AND integer_value IS NULL AND number_value IS NULL AND boolean_value IS NULL)OR(value_type = 'integer' AND text_value IS NULL AND integer_value IS NOT NULL AND number_value IS NULL AND boolean_value IS NULL)OR(value_type = 'number' AND text_value IS NULL AND integer_value IS NULL AND number_value IS NOT NULL AND boolean_value IS NULL)OR(value_type = 'boolean' AND text_value IS NULL AND integer_value IS NULL AND number_value IS NULL AND boolean_value IS NOT NULL)OR(value_type = 'null' AND text_value IS NULL AND integer_value IS NULL AND number_value IS NULL AND boolean_value IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_identity_mappings" ("mapping_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY COLLATE BINARY CHECK (length(mapping_id) > 0), "dataset_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY REFERENCES migration_datasets(dataset_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "entity_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entity_kind IN ('source', 'book', 'shelf', 'group')), "legacy_key" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "mapping_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (mapping_version > 0), "resolution" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (resolution IN ('unresolved', 'resolved', 'conflict')), "source_by_id_name" TEXT, "book_source_name" TEXT, "target_source_id" TEXT COLLATE BINARY REFERENCES source_registrations(source_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "target_book_id" TEXT COLLATE BINARY, "target_shelf_id" TEXT COLLATE BINARY REFERENCES shelves(shelf_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "target_group_id" TEXT COLLATE BINARY REFERENCES manual_groups(group_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, UNIQUE(dataset_id, entity_kind, legacy_key, mapping_version), FOREIGN KEY(target_source_id, target_book_id)REFERENCES library_entries(source_id, book_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK(target_book_id IS NULL OR target_source_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK(resolution != 'resolved' OR(entity_kind = 'source' AND target_source_id IS NOT NULL)OR(entity_kind = 'book' AND target_source_id IS NOT NULL AND target_book_id IS NOT NULL)OR(entity_kind = 'shelf' AND target_shelf_id IS NOT NULL)OR(entity_kind = 'group' AND target_group_id IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_chapter_locators" ("locator_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY COLLATE BINARY CHECK (length(locator_id) > 0), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (version = 1), "dataset_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY REFERENCES migration_datasets(dataset_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "legacy_book_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY CHECK (length(legacy_book_id) > 0), "chapter_index" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (chapter_index >= 0), "raw_offset_key" TEXT, "fraction" REAL CHECK (fraction IS NULL OR fraction BETWEEN 0 AND 1), "remote_id_evidence" TEXT, "chapter_title_evidence" TEXT, "volume_title_evidence" TEXT, "catalog_digest" TEXT, UNIQUE(source_id, book_id, locator_id), FOREIGN KEY(source_id, book_id)REFERENCES library_entries(source_id, book_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_progress" ("source_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (version = 1), "has_read" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (has_read IN (0, 1)), "chapter_id" TEXT COLLATE BINARY CHECK (chapter_id IS NULL OR(length(chapter_id) > 0 AND instr(chapter_id, char(0)) = 0)), "legacy_locator_id" TEXT COLLATE BINARY, "last_read_at" TEXT CHECK (last_read_at IS NULL OR(last_read_at GLOB '????-??-??T??:??:??.*Z' AND julianday(last_read_at) IS NOT NULL)), PRIMARY KEY(source_id, book_id), FOREIGN KEY(source_id, book_id)REFERENCES library_entries(source_id, book_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY(source_id, book_id, legacy_locator_id)REFERENCES legacy_chapter_locators(source_id, book_id, locator_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reader_preferences" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (version = 1), "font_size" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 22 CHECK (font_size > 0 AND(font_size - font_size)IS NOT NULL), "line_spacing" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 8 CHECK (line_spacing >= 0 AND(line_spacing - line_spacing)IS NOT NULL), "background" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'paperWhite' CHECK (background IN ('paperWhite', 'parchment', 'darkGray', 'black', 'eyeCare')), "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pageCurl' CHECK (mode IN ('pageCurl', 'scroll')), "font_family" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kaiti' CHECK (font_family IN ('system', 'songti', 'kaiti', 'yuanti')), "bold" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (bold IN (0, 1)), "margin_left" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 35 CHECK (margin_left >= 0 AND(margin_left - margin_left)IS NOT NULL), "margin_right" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 35 CHECK (margin_right >= 0 AND(margin_right - margin_right)IS NOT NULL), "margin_top" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 72 CHECK (margin_top >= 0 AND(margin_top - margin_top)IS NOT NULL), "margin_bottom" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 24 CHECK (margin_bottom >= 0 AND(margin_bottom - margin_bottom)IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_preferences" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (version = 1), "theme" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (theme IN ('system', 'light', 'dark')), "preferred_source_id" TEXT COLLATE BINARY REFERENCES source_registrations(source_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "selected_shelf_id" TEXT COLLATE BINARY REFERENCES shelves(shelf_id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "accent" TEXT CHECK (accent IS NULL OR accent IN ('purple', 'blue', 'teal', 'pink', 'orange', 'red')));
